properties.text: The Russian rate of advance across the theater was 2.91 square kilometers per day in August 2026, a slight increase compared to recent months.[11] The average Russian rate of advance for Russian forces’ priority effort in Donetsk Oblast was lower at only 2.36 square kilometers per day in August.

Russian forces continued limited offensive operations in the Pokrovsk, Novopavlivka, and Oleksandrivka directions on September 4 and 5 but did not advance.[41] Ukrainian forces continued their intermediate-range strike campaign against Russian military assets in occupied Donetsk Oblast.

Ukrainian forces recently advanced west of Kotlyarivka (just east of Novopavlivka) according to geolocated footage published on September 3.[56] Russian forces continued limited offensive operations in the Oleksandrivka direction on September 3 and 4 but did not advance.[57] Ukrainian forces continued their intermediate-range strike campaign against Russian military assets in occupied Donetsk Oblast.
